summary: Chicago area resident, electronics technician, former system administrator, programming background in Turbo Pascal and Delphi, current interest in Lazarus/Free Pascal, hobbyist in CNC machining and metalworking, strong interest in capability-based security in operating systems, engaged in amateur radio since 1979, interest in software-defined radio, has a child, experiences with long-term health issues post-COVID, active in online programming communities, interest in computational fabrics and FPGA programming, critical of modern programming languages and trends, values historical knowledge in technology and programming, advocates for user privacy and data ownership.
